allow: PowerShell($conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $conns | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess; "$\($_.LocalAddress\):$\($_.LocalPort\) PID=$\($p.Id\) Name=$\($p.ProcessName\) Path=$\($p.Path\)" })

PowerShell($p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=18884"; "Cmd: $\($p.CommandLine\)"; "Parent: $\($p.ParentProcessId\)"; $pp = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$\($p.ParentProcessId\)" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "ParentCmd: $\($pp.CommandLine\)")

PowerShell($mine = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'nodemon' -and $_.ProcessId -ne 4100 }; $mine | ForEach-Object { "Stopping PID $\($_.ProcessId\): $\($_.CommandLine\)"; Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -Confirm:$false }; Start-Sleep 2; Invoke-RestMethod http://localhost:5000/api/v1/health | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)

PowerShell($c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { $pid5000 = $c.OwningProcess | Select-Object -Unique; "Port 5000 PID: $pid5000" } else { "Nothing listening on 5000" }; $nm = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'node.exe' }; $nm | ForEach-Object { "node PID $\($_.ProcessId\) parent=$\($_.ParentProcessId\): $\($_.CommandLine\)" }; try { Invoke-RestMethod http://localhost:5000/api/v1/health -ErrorAction Stop | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } catch { "Health check FAILED: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })
